blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A motorcycle rider, whom authorities claimed had just come from a drinking spree in Balamban town, died after the motorcycle he was driving crashed into a traffic signpost at the Transcentral Highway in Barangay Tabunan, Cebu City. Authorities identified the dead victim as Marc Lance Felices, 23, a resident of Barangay Luz, Cebu City. He was the driver of the motorcycle.
